@returns The address on the other end of a TCP stream, as a number for [DottedIP](DottedIP).
@param tcp_stream  The stream.
@gap A peer that uses IPv6 has no address as a number, so this returns 0 for it; use [GetTCPStreamAddress](GetTCPStreamAddress). IPv4 peers are not changed.
